SELECT AVG(daily_reg) FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(c.stat_date) AS dd, COUNT(1) AS daily_reg FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON c.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE c.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.stat_date) )

SELECT AVG(daily_appoint) FROM ( SELECT a.appoint_date, SUM(a.appoint_count) AS daily_appoint FROM tr_fc_appoint a LEFT JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.appoint_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY a.appoint_date )
SELECT SUM(a.appoint_count) FROM tr_fc_appoint a LEFT JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.appoint_date = #{appointDate}
SELECT hol_date FROM tr_fc_holiday WHERE hol_type = 'LEGAL_HOLIDAY' AND hol_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY hol_date DESC

SELECT MAX(c.stat_date) FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.stat_date < #{beforeDate} AND TO_CHAR(c.stat_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') NOT IN ('SAT', 'SUN') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tr_fc_holiday h WHERE h.hol_date = c.stat_date)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON c.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE c.stat_date = #{statDate}

SELECT TO_CHAR(c.stat_date, 'MM') AS forecastMonth, COUNT(1) AS forecastValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON c.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE TO_CHAR(c.stat_date, 'YYYY') = #{year}
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(c.stat_date, 'MM') ORDER BY forecastMonth
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON c.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE c.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
